avis.titre: The BEST Vitamin C serum, better formulation than Obagi and TruSkinThe BEST Vitamin C serum, better formulation than Oba
avis.texte: I first purchased the MediHeal Vitamin C Brightening Serum with Niacinimide on a whim at a Don Quixote on a trip to Tokyo, Japan and am so glad that I gave this a try! I was so relieved that Amazon carried it and repurchased it here. This serum feels a lot more luxurious and smooth on the skin, absorbs well, and using it every morning under Bioré sunscreen has made a noticeable difference in skin brightness and texture. I’ve tried other vitamin C serums like the Obagi Vitamin C + Arbutin Brightening Serum and the TruSkin Vitamin C Serum but both leave a crusty dried film on the skin that increases tightness and sensitivity to skin irritation rather than hydration like this serum does. Almost as importantly, unlike the abovementioned other serums, this one DOES NOT PILL under makeup!

This is such a good product!! I have purchased it multiple times and it never fails to impress me.after starting this serum, my skin got a lot brighter. It did break me out a little bit when I first started using it but that was my fault for not bringing it in slowly. It absorbed very well and was not sticky. It was decently hydrating and the scent was there but not too strong. Overall it base my skin very soft and bright. I highly Recommend!

This gem offers a radiant glow without burning a hole in your wallet. Priced inexpensively, it's a steal considering its effectiveness. It leaves my skin feeling supple and moisturized, which is a must, especially in harsh weather or after a long day. But what truly sets it apart is its brightening effect. My complexion has noticeably improved since I started using it, with a healthy glow that's hard to miss. Pairing it with Belif Aqua moisturizer has been a winning combination for me. The two products seem to complement each other perfectly, enhancing the overall results. However, I'd recommend starting with a small amount, especially for those with sensitive skin. My friend, who falls into this category, found that using smaller amounts helped her enjoy the benefits without any adverse reactions. If you're on the hunt for an affordable Vitamin C serum that delivers, look no further than MEDIHEAL. It's a budget-friendly option that doesn't compromise on quality.

I got this after a lymes flare and multiple weather changes left my skin with herx-like reactions. On.my.face.and my arms. I couldn't smell it when i got it, but everything is off for me. It is not too thick, went on easily if used sparingly. I went against instructions and rubbed it in the spots like you would a cleanser. It was a bit sticky for me, but im not used to using much but an spf 50 spray. I used this serum Twice a day. After a week my skin is softer in the shower where I used it. Its starting to clear up slowly. For a serum to do that to my face and arms impressed me. Im not as embarrassed with my skin reactions now and happy how much more quickly this helped minimize it. Nice product.
I really enjoy this serum on my mature, dry skin. Have purchased several bottles. With consistency, it does fade dark spots.

avis.titre: Affordable better quality that USA products
avis.texte: Bought this stuff on a trip to Japan and went through an entire bottle because I loved it so much. Once I ran out I went back to my old vitamin c stuff that is twice the price and realized it didn’t work as well as this so I had to find it online. So happy I found it! Bought some for my sister as a gift. This will be the only vitamin c I buy from now on.

avis.titre: True vitamin C serum power!True vitamin C serum power!
avis.texte: I think this one is the best vitamin C serum I've tried so far! I always check the components of products, and I find this one is one of the few that has the specific amount written in it (150ppm). It also comes in a black bottle which is a must considering vitamin C quickly deteriorates in sunlight. The citrus smell is quite strong which is not a bad thing because you know that it does contain a considerable amount of vitamin C. Hence, it stings a bit but leaves my skin quite smooth (albeit it didn't address the gaping size of my pores - which the issue is sometimes genetic), glowing and fairly hydrated.

avis.titre: 良い匂いでテンション上がる！
avis.texte: 良い匂いで朝からテンション上がります！ あと、肌がプルプル！ でも肝心な美白効果は…無い！！！！！ 美白効果がほしかったのにー(；'Д｀) 肌プルプルさせたいときや、テンション上げたいときに香水感覚で使ってます。 あと、肌弱い自分にも使えたのでそれは有り難いです。美白効果付いたらいいなぁ〜。

I’ve used vitamin c serum for a few years already. I am not loyal to a particular brand, so when someone recommended this vitamin c serum to me, I was more than happy to get it when it was offered to me. The scent is pleasant. The texture is thin, runny and a little sticky when rubbed into skin. It hydrates really well and leaves a glow that lasted for a while although not too long. With continued use, it would brighten and fade dark spots slowly. Overall a good quality product at a decent price.

If you’re looking for something to make your skin glow, then this is the product for it. It is it is gentle, clean, lightweight, and it has a non-greasy texture. It helps with scars and dark spots. It helps with the overall skin elasticity of the face. I’ve seen my skin look younger, and everybody’s complimented me on my skin and I credited to this product. I would buy a hundred bottles if I could.

I have been using this vitamin c serum daily for two weeks and absolutely love it! It is easy to apply, has a very mild citrus scent that I enjoy, and leaves my face so smooth and hydrated. My face has not been this soft and smooth in ages, and I feel like I am seeing results already. I like that it also includes niacinamide and hyaluronic acid for brightening and hydration. I am so glad I found this serum! I did notice a bit of the fake tan look after a few days (common with asorbic acid, and this is the first vitamin c serum I've tried). I incorporated a toner into my routine before this serum and it's gone a little over a week later. I will definitely be looking into more Mediheal products in the future!

This “Mediheal Vitamin C Brightening serum” is an antioxidant and brightening serum for your face. After the toner, I applied this serum and then followed by moisturizer. The liquid is easily absorbed by the skin leaving it fresh and glowing. It is lightweight and not greasy. It has a light bergamot-like scent but disappeared after applying my moisturizer. I have been using this for a week and could not comment yet if it really brightens my skin and fades those dark spots due to sun damage and I guess part of the aging process as well. I did not experience any skin irritation or allergic reaction. Overall my skin is happy with it and I can give this product two thumbs up!

I'm becoming a big fan of vitamin c serums, and this one is no exception. It has that typical oily feel of a vitamin c serum but sinks in well into the skin, not too sticky either. The bottle design is really nice, and I'm enjoying this brand overall!

So far I really love this serum. I use It at night and my face has started to clear and glow in just a couple of days. It also doesn’t sting like most Vitamin C serums I’ve encountered. Definitely recommend.

avis.titre: Had a reaction on my face but my skin is super sensitive
avis.texte: I used this but my face got very red afterwards and felt hot. I beleive I had an allergic reaction to it. Not really sure what my skin reacted to though? I had to wash it right off so I Apologize but I can't accurately review the item. I was very hopeful with this serum because I've heard many great things about vit C lightening serums Like this. I've even had some other ones that were similar, but I never had this reaction to them.

I always have to take off a star if a beauty product does not include the ingredients in the Amazon listing, and as of the time of my review, they are not there, but I have provided a photo with them. Otherwise, I am pleased with this serum, it has a light orange type scent, it doesn't irritate my skin or cause breakouts, and it helps smooth and brighten my skin. I use it after washing and toning my face and before my moisturizer.

avis.titre: Lightly scented, hydrating vita c serum
avis.texte: This serum has the lightest citrus scent which I appreciate. I've used a handful of vitamin c serums before but this is my first from Mediheal and I am quite pleased. It's lightweight and just a tad sticky but that goes away when you apply moisturizer. It very much gives you a lot of hydration but as for brightening that will take more than 4 weeks to see true results. It is enjoyable to use, sometimes vitamin c serums can feel icky but this makes my skin feel soft and leaves a nice glow behind. I will definitely be finishing this serum up!

I used this vitamin c serum after cleaning and toning my face. The texture was nice, very much a serum. There was a very very faint citrus smell. I appreciated that it came in an amber bottle to avoid light contamination. I had no problems with irritation but did find my skin was a little drier the next day so I'd used with a moisturizer.
